build_optimizer: build an optax Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate schedule and weight decay for the AlphaStar learner
create_staircase_schedule: create a staircase learning rate schedule that drops the rate by a factor at regular update intervals
create_cosine_schedule: create a cosine decay learning rate schedule that smoothly reduces the rate after a warmup period
add_warmup_to_schedule: add a linear warmup phase to any existing learning rate schedule before decay begins
filter_layer_norm_weights: filter out layer normalization parameters from weight decay using a Haiku data structure mask
